contract: Sprint 28f Stage 0, measurement 3: the instrument that DERIVES the map band
of the architecture's section 8, and the control that keeps it honest.
THREE SETS, three different jobs, and they must never be collapsed:
unrelated  - a task and a job with nothing to do with each other. Their
p95 distance is the FLOOR the map bar must sit above. This
set is what makes a bar a measurement instead of a choice.
designated - a task and the ONE job it must find. Every pair here must
clear the floor, or the bar is too high to be useful.
near_dupes - two wordings of the SAME job. This is the dedup edge, a
DIFFERENT band with a different job (architecture section 8),
and a bar derived from it would pass exactly the near-misses
the map exists to separate.
THE DISCRIMINATING PROPERTY, and the reason this fixture can fail: every
designated task is worded as an agent would actually ask it, and shares as
few content words with its job as the question allows. A task that quoted
its job's wording would be answered by keyword matching and would prove
nothing about meaning.
FROZEN BEFORE THE CODE ON PURPOSE. A corpus written after the retrieval
path exists measures the path; a corpus pointed at the live store measures
the store. Neither answers what band to set. The jobs below are written by
hand against capabilities this product really has, and no row here is taken
from the store.

jobs.summary: Take a consistent copy of the open knowledge store before a verb that destroys rows.
Rewrite a method's parameter list and every call site that passes to it.
Answer where a fully qualified symbol currently sits in the source, at the moment it is read.
Turn an entry's text into a meaning vector so it can be recalled by paraphrase.
Refuse a stored experience that states no situation and no outcome.
Fold a subclass that adds nothing into its parent and repoint every reference to it.
Find methods whose bodies are the same code with different identifiers.
Run the project's tests in a forked machine and report which lines they reached.
Suspend a running program at a chosen line and read the values it holds there.
Rank stored knowledge against a question and hand back only what fits.
